top_findings: No responsive images or next-gen formats (WebP/AVIF) on any of the 57 posts — biggest performance lever available
Several in-article images (below the fold) missing loading="lazy" entirely
35 of 57 post titles exceed 60 characters, risking SERP truncation
No Content-Security-Policy header (all other modern security headers present)
Backlink profile is effectively zero (expected for ~1-month-old domain, not a technical issue)
quick_wins: Add loading="lazy" to in-article images (keep hero as eager/fetchpriority=high)
Convert images to WebP with srcset/responsive sizes
Trim the 10-15 worst over-length titles to under 60 characters
Add a basic Content-Security-Policy header via vercel.json
Add FAQPage schema to the homepage to match the depth already used on every blog post

categories.name: Technical SEO
what_works: robots.txt permissive and correct, references sitemap-index.xml
Valid sitemap index -> sitemap-0.xml containing all 70 site URLs
Canonical tags present and self-referential on every page checked
HTTPS enforced with 2-year HSTS
Strong security headers: X-Content-Type-Options, X-Frame-Options, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy
Fast TTFB (~190ms) via Vercel edge cache
Mobile viewport meta tag present on all pages
Flat, descriptive, keyword-relevant URL structure
Third-party scripts (GTM/gtag/Clarity) deliberately deferred to window load event for LCP, with documented rationale

findings.title: No Content-Security-Policy header
findings.description: curl -sI on homepage and post pages shows no CSP header of any kind.
findings.recommendation: Add a CSP via vercel.json headers config or Astro middleware, starting permissive and tightening after verification.

findings.title: HSTS missing includeSubDomains/preload
findings.recommendation: Add includeSubDomains; preload once confirmed safe, then consider HSTS preload list submission.

findings.title: HTTP protocol version not directly verified
findings.description: Local curl build lacked --http2 support in this environment.
findings.recommendation: Not actionable; Vercel serves HTTP/2+ by default in virtually all cases.

categories.name: Content Quality
what_works: No thin content: word counts ranged ~1,479-3,249 across sample
No duplicate titles or meta descriptions across all 57 posts (full-corpus check)
Strong E-E-A-T signals: Person schema per post, /about and /author pages, first-hand-tested framing, real CAD pricing and named Canadian retailers
FAQ sections present and schema-marked on every sampled post
Editorial policy page exists (/editorial-policy)

findings.title: Homepage lacks the same schema depth as posts
findings.description: Homepage carries WebSite/Organization schema but not the FAQPage/Person combination posts have.
findings.recommendation: Add 3-4 FAQ entries to the homepage with FAQPage schema.

findings.title: Content freshness/update cadence not independently verified
findings.description: dateModified values in schema weren't spot-checked against actual content diffs in this run.
findings.recommendation: Confirm dateModified only updates on genuine content edits, not on every deploy.

categories.name: On-Page SEO
what_works: Exactly one H1 per page across homepage + all 19 sampled posts
Meta descriptions present on 100% of pages checked
Complete Open Graph tags on homepage
Strong internal linking: 11-13 unique internal /blog/ links per sampled post
Real heading hierarchy depth (19 H2s observed on one sampled post)

findings.title: 35 of 57 post titles exceed 60 characters
findings.description: Longest observed titles run 82-88 characters, risking SERP truncation around 55-60 chars.
findings.recommendation: Trim to primary keyword + short qualifier; prioritize the 10-15 worst offenders first.

findings.title: Some meta descriptions exceed ~200 characters
findings.description: E.g. the bike-storage post description is 205 chars vs a ~155-160 char SERP display limit.
findings.recommendation: Trim to ~155 chars, front-load the value proposition.

categories.name: Schema / Structured Data
what_works: Consistent BlogPosting + FAQPage + BreadcrumbList + Person + Organization + WebSite + ImageObject JSON-LD across all 19 sampled posts, indicating reliable templating across all 57 posts
No schema type mismatches or deprecated types observed

findings.title: Homepage schema lighter than post schema
findings.description: Homepage has WebSite/Organization but not FAQPage/BreadcrumbList.
findings.recommendation: Add FAQ schema to homepage, mirroring the post-level pattern.

findings.title: Not independently validated against Google's Rich Results Test
findings.description: JSON-LD checked via pattern matching only, not Google's live validator.

categories.name: Performance
what_works: Fast TTFB (~190ms) via Vercel edge cache
Font files correctly preloaded (WOFF2, crossorigin set)
Hero/LCP image correctly marked loading=eager fetchpriority=high
Related-post thumbnails correctly use loading=lazy
Third-party scripts deliberately deferred off the critical rendering path with measured, documented LCP improvement (5-6s to 2-3s)

findings.title: No responsive images (srcset/sizes) anywhere checked
findings.description: Every img ships one fixed-size file (e.g. 1600x900 hero) regardless of viewport; mobile downloads desktop-resolution files.
findings.recommendation: Add srcset with 2-3 widths per image, generated at build time via Astro's astro:assets/<Image> component if not already used.

findings.title: No next-gen image formats
findings.description: All images observed are JPG/PNG; hero image is 149KB as JPEG.
findings.recommendation: Convert to WebP with JPG picture fallback, or serve via Astro's image optimization pipeline.

findings.title: Mid-article images missing loading attribute entirely
findings.description: 3 of 9 images on the sampled post have no loading attribute (not lazy, not eager), competing with the actual LCP candidate for bandwidth.
findings.recommendation: Add loading="lazy" explicitly to every in-article image except the hero.

findings.title: No field CWV data pulled in this audit
findings.description: This run used lab/static signals only; PageSpeed Insights/CrUX field data was not pulled.
findings.recommendation: Run https://pagespeed.web.dev/ manually on 2-3 URLs, or use the blog-google skill's PageSpeed integration if GSC/GA4 credentials exist for this property.

categories.name: Images
what_works: Zero missing alt text across all 57 posts (full-corpus check)
Decorative images correctly use alt="" with aria-hidden="true"
All images have explicit width/height attributes (prevents CLS)
Graceful onerror fallback handling on hero/related images

findings.title: JPG/PNG only, no modern formats
findings.description: Duplicate of the Performance finding, listed here as an Images-category issue too.

categories.name: AI Search Readiness
what_works: llms.txt exists at /llms.txt with clear site summary, scope, links, and explicit AI-attribution instructions
robots.txt has no disallow rules blocking AI crawlers (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, Google-Extended, etc.)
FAQPage schema with Q&A pairs on every post gives AI answer engines pre-structured extractable content
Content is specific and citable (real prices, real retailer names, first-hand testing claims)
RSS feed exists and is referenced in llms.txt

findings.title: No ai.txt (404)
findings.description: ai.txt is a newer, less-standardized convention; llms.txt (the more established one) is present and solid.
findings.recommendation: Not urgent; consider adding as a redundant signal only if the convention gains adoption.

findings.title: Author/entity external authority not deeply verified
findings.description: Person schema and /author page exist but external authority linkage (sameAs) wasn't verified.
findings.recommendation: Consider linking author Person schema sameAs to a consistent external profile (e.g. Pinterest business profile).

phases.name: Phase 2: High-Impact Improvements
items: Add loading="lazy" to all in-article images except hero
Convert images to WebP with responsive srcset (Astro image optimization pipeline)

phases.name: Phase 3: Content & Authority
items: Shorten the 10-15 worst over-length title tags (currently up to 88 chars)
Trim meta descriptions running past ~160 characters
Add FAQPage schema to the homepage
Run live PageSpeed Insights/CrUX check on 2-3 URLs to replace lab-estimated Performance score

phases.name: Phase 4: Monitoring & Iteration
items: Add includeSubDomains; preload to HSTS and consider preload list submission
Add ai.txt as a redundant AI-crawler signal
Validate JSON-LD via Google's Rich Results Test
Confirm dateModified only changes on genuine content edits
Link author Person schema sameAs to external authority profile
Continue Pinterest-driven promotion to build backlink/authority profile over time
